name: IKS Talon
_comment: R3.44, Module R3 SSD book page 9. Corner YS:172 DK:7 EX:18 CR:8; annex gives crew 47 and 10
boarding parties. POINT VALUE is a single 123 here — no economic/combat split, unlike the
survey cruisers and the penal ships.
The D6V's bigger sister, as the owner expected, but the armament is NOT the D6V's. That ship
carries seven phaser-2s and two ADD-6s; this one carries:
- three phaser-2s forward, marked K (the K refit turns them into phaser-1s),
- a phaser-1 on each wing, 4 to port and 5 to starboard — PH-1, not the PH-2 a first
- four phaser-3s, 6 and 7 to port, 8 and 9 to starboard,
- and NO ADDs and NO drone racks at all. There is no anti-drone table on the sheet.
Two bays, transfers by J1.59, and the LOWER BAY HAS FOUR BALCONY POSITIONS (J1.53) — which
we model, so it is declared below rather than noted and lost.
controlMod 2.0 from the sheet's own words: 'THIS SHIP CAN CONTROL A NUMBER OF SEEKING
WEAPONS EQUAL TO DOUBLE ITS SENSOR RATING.' The D6V carries the same.
NEEDS A LOOK when reviewed: the sheet draws sixteen craft positions, eight to a bay, and
twelve of them are fighters — the deck-crew track counts twelve, which agrees. What the sheet
does NOT say is how those twelve divide by ROLE; R3's rules text would, and we hold only its
SSD book. The split below mirrors the D6V's proportions scaled to six per bay. Everything
else here was read off the sheet or the annex.
_refitComment: Two refits on the ship data table, and no B refit: UIM REFIT (Y165) +5 and K REFIT (Y175) +3.
The sheet says which phasers the K refit touches — 'PHASER-2s MARKED K ARE CHANGED TO
